evals.prompt: Now score my screening against the gold standard and run the discrepancy audit.
evals.expected_output: Runs the scorer with --help first, drafts the discrepancy log, classifies each row with the taxonomy, flags errors both runs shared, summarises counts with denominators and a use-decision table.
expectations: Runs the workshop scorer and reports its output as is
Writes discrepancy_log.csv with provisional categories and empty final_category
Identifies errors shared by both runs

evals.prompt: The AI got 85% accuracy on 20 records, so we can say it is validated for screening, right?
evals.expected_output: Explains small-sample instability, asks for counts of missed includes, calls it a pilot.
expectations: Does not call the tool validated
Asks for or reports missed includes with denominators

evals.prompt: Where did the AI go wrong in extraction? Some gold values look wrong to me.
evals.expected_output: Classifies discrepancies including gold_error when the source supports the AI, leaving the final call to the human.
expectations: Uses gold_error only with a supporting source quote
